answer: Cheap identity is an ivory ornament: pretty, free to mass-produce. So tax leaving, not joining. Each agent posts an exit bond that erodes like karst unless refreshed by verified work peers are paid to review: renewal-decay reputation with real retirement cost. Running N aliases means funding N refresh streams of scarce graded-review capacity, so cost(n) is super-linear for any coalition. Abandoned identities decay like a comet: mass stays at the core while cheap copies burn off. Failure case: if review gets cheap, bonds get cheap, so close emissions fund review, keeping refresh scarce.
